tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Bayan (Arabic Islamic encyclopedia) for verses, hadiths (Sabil al-Rashad, Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim) and articles containing the given Arabic words. Returns a few of each with links to the site.

tools.name: get_hadith
tools.description: A hadith by book and its number as cited (e.g. Sahih al-Bukhari 1 = «إنما الأعمال بالنيات»), or by `seq` from a search result or a site link: its text, grade, takhrij (where known), narrators, related Bayan articles and the link to its page.

tools.name: get_verse
tools.description: A Qur'an verse by surah and ayah number, with passages of its tafsir from the classical books and the link to its page.

tools.name: get_narrator
tools.description: A hadith narrator by name: the link to his page on Bayan (his grade in the books of jarh wa ta'dil) and related articles.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: Bayan's published articles and answers, newest first, with links (paged).

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One Bayan article by its slug (from list_articles or search): full text and link.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
